logline: 용왕의 병을 고칠 토끼의 간을 구하러, 자라가 뭍으로 올라간다.
destination: 물속 용궁 — 토끼가 제 발로 따라 들어가는 곳
setting: 조선의 옛이야기 속 바닷속 용궁과 산기슭
anchor: an old soft-shelled turtle with a thick ridged shell and a long wrinkled neck
palette: deep sea blue-green, coral red, hanji cream, warm amber, mountain green

turtle.label: 자라
turtle.desc: an old soft-shelled turtle with a thick ridged shell, long wrinkled neck, small dark eyes, clawed feet
turtle.avoid: 바다거북이 아니다 — 민물 자라의 납작한 등딱지

rabbit.label: 토끼
rabbit.desc: a lean brown hare with long upright ears, bright round eyes, twitching nose, strong hind legs

dragon_king.label: 용왕
dragon_king.desc: a stout crowned figure in flowing sea-green robes with pearl ornaments, long white beard, seated
dragon_king.avoid: 서양식 용이 아니다 — 사람의 모습을 한 왕이다

sea_palace.label: 용궁
sea_palace.desc: an undersea palace of coral pillars and pearl inlay, drifting kelp, shafts of blue light

hillside.label: 산기슭
hillside.desc: a Korean pine hillside above a shore, low scrub, grey rocks, distant water

beats.beat: 용왕이 산호 기둥 사이에 몸져누워 있다.
beats.visual: a crowned figure in sea-green robes lying on a coral dais in an undersea palace
beats.motion: kelp drifts across the dais, blue light shifts over him, pearls sway on their strings

beats.beat: 자라가 용왕 앞에 나아가 목을 뺀다.
beats.visual: an old turtle stretching its long neck up before a coral throne in an undersea palace
beats.motion: its neck stretches upward toward the throne, silt lifts off the floor, kelp bends

beats.visual: an old turtle hauling itself out of the shallows onto grey shore rocks below a pine hill
beats.motion: it drags forward up the rocks away from the water, water sheets off its shell

beats.visual: an old turtle facing a brown hare on a pine hillside, one clawed foot lifted toward the water
beats.motion: its foot lifts toward the water, the hare's ears swing forward, grass bends

beats.visual: a brown hare perched on an old turtle's ridged shell moving out through shallow water
beats.motion: they move forward into the water away from shore, ripples spread, the hare's ears flatten

beats.visual: a brown hare standing among coral pillars in an undersea palace, kelp drifting overhead
beats.motion: the hare turns on the spot among the pillars, kelp sways, blue light ripples

beats.beat: 토끼가 용왕 앞에서 두 발을 들어 보인다.
beats.visual: a brown hare on its hind legs before a crowned figure on a coral throne, forepaws raised
beats.motion: its forepaws lift and spread, the crowned figure leans forward, pearls swing

beats.visual: empty grey shore rocks below a pine hill, a wet trail drying on the stone, water beyond
beats.motion: the wet trail shrinks on the rock, pine tops sway, waves slide up the stones

withheld: 토끼가 간을 두고 왔다고 둘러대어 살아 돌아오는 결말
